ambient_events: A taxi goes past toward the terminal with its light off.
A jet lifts off beyond the fence and the noise arrives a second later.
description: Airport Road leaves Kessler Street between the fuel yard and the runway fence, two lanes of new asphalt with the paint still bright. A sign on a gantry says COLDWATER REGIONAL with an arrow north, and under it, smaller, PARKING.
name: Airport Road
